items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: And she'd see Marvin on the book.

ctx.x: Dance, man. Every night, playing the houses, the Tanya Street, all in the big white people.

Take Rene and Rene's band. Rene had his wife, she had a big book, a record book. And she would take dates while he'd be out. They'd ring up. And she'd see Marvin on the book. Yeah. This was my job, different places, all from different around here. We have just about another minute or two on the show. We have just about another minute or two on the show.

We have a job for every night and week. We have just about another minute or two on here and we won't bother you anymore. But I was going to ask a couple of questions like about Tom Anderson when you played for him. Where did you play? Where did you play? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
